description:
Project: Provision-to-ready automation sprint (Dedicated Capacity & Fleet Management).

Goal
- Reduce “time-to-ready” for new Dedicated GPU capacity by automating the end-to-end lifecycle: provision infrastructure, apply hardened base images, bootstrap runtime/k8s components, push validated configuration, and run readiness/benchmark checks before handing capacity to routing.
- Improve reliability and predictability of Dedicated bring-up so Sales/CS can commit to shorter lead times and SRE sees fewer noisy handoffs.

Scope (what changes)
- Fleet provisioning pipeline: standard, repeatable workflow triggered by a customer pool request (or capacity expansion) that performs infra provisioning (Terraform/IaC), node imaging, cluster bootstrap, and registration in control plane.
- Image + config standardization: versioned “golden” images, pinned runtime versions, and a config schema with validation (lint + policy checks) to prevent known misconfigurations.
- Readiness gates: automated smoke tests, networking checks, GPU health checks, and a lightweight perf-canary run to validate throughput/latency before marking capacity “ready”.
- Observability + reporting: dashboards and alerts for each stage (provisioning, imaging, bootstrap, validation), plus a single “time-to-ready” metric broken down by stage.

Non-goals
- Major redesign of the serving runtime itself.
- Replacing the entire procurement process or changing vendor contracts.
- Building a fully customer-self-serve provisioning UI (only minimal operator-facing hooks/CLI if needed).

Stakeholders
- Infra Fleet & Capacity: Irene Choi (Dir Infra Eng), Vanessa Ortiz (Eng Manager, Fleet), Nina Petrova/Jamal Pierce/Keiko Yamamoto (infra engineers).
- SRE: Sean Gallagher (Dir SRE), Rafael Mendes (SRE Mgr), Miles Thornton/Aisha Bello (SREs).
- Platform Control Plane/Routing: Priya Natarajan (VP Eng Platform), Ethan Park (EM Control Plane), Mina Haddad (EM Routing), Benji Okafor/Jordan Lee/Ravi Menon (eng).
- Product (Dedicated): Lauren Bishop (Dir Product, Dedicated).
- Security Engineering (as needed for image hardening/secrets): Marcus Lin/Kevin Osei.

Timeline (single sprint, with rollout)
- Week 1: Baseline measurement + failure-mode inventory; agree on target SLA for provisioning lead time and stage budgets; finalize design/ADR(s).
- Week 2: Implement automation pipeline primitives (IaC orchestration + image build hooks + config validation); add initial metrics.
- Week 3: Add readiness gates, perf-canary integration, and control-plane “ready” state transitions; dashboards + alerting.
- Week 4: Pilot on 1–2 internal pools + 1 customer expansion; iterate; document runbooks; retro; plan follow-on hardening.

Key deliverables
- Confluence design/ADRs + runbooks.
- Linear project with issues mapped to pipeline stages.
- GitHub PRs implementing orchestration, validation, and observability.
- Slack coordination threads and incident-style threads for early pilot hiccups.
- Drive working docs (capacity timing spreadsheet, stage timing baseline, rollout checklist).

Constraints/risks
- Must support multiple regions and heterogeneous GPU SKUs; avoid brittle SKU-specific assumptions.
- Rollouts must be safe: partial automation allowed with manual override; clear rollback points.
- Avoid regressions to existing Dedicated pool expansions; ensure config validation doesn’t block legitimate edge cases without an escape hatch and auditing.
- Ensure secrets handling and image provenance meet security requirements (signed artifacts, least privilege).

files.description: High-level overview of the provision-to-ready pipeline: stages, owners, SLAs, and current pain points; includes a stage timing budget table and definitions for “ready” vs “provisioned”.
Proposed Terraform module layout for Dedicated pools (networking, compute, security groups, cluster bootstrap), including versioning and environment conventions (staging/prod).
Service doc for a new/expanded internal service responsible for orchestrating provisioning workflows, state transitions, and retries; includes API endpoints/events and ownership.
Definition of time-to-ready metrics, dashboards, and alerts (stage breakdown, p50/p95 targets, failure rates, retry counts) plus paging thresholds and runbook links.
SLO proposal for provisioning readiness (e.g., % pools ready within X hours) and error-budget policy for automation failures; includes reporting cadence.
ADR comparing orchestration options (CI-driven, workflow engine, internal service + queue) with decision, rationale, trade-offs, and rollout plan.
ADR defining config schema, validation/linting, and policy gates (with an audited break-glass mechanism) to prevent known misconfigurations.
Operator runbook for provisioning/expanding a Dedicated pool using the new automation: prerequisites, commands, expected outputs, common failures, rollback points, and escalation.
Runbook for building and promoting golden images (build pipeline, artifact signing, rollback, and compatibility matrix with runtime versions).
Troubleshooting guide for cases where infra is up but control plane does not mark capacity as ready; includes logs to check and state machine transitions.
Spec for a dedicated readiness dashboard: widgets, filters by customer/pool/region, drilldowns to stage-level events, and links to PRs/runbooks.
Sprint retrospective capturing what shipped, what didn’t, stage timing improvements, incidents during pilot, and follow-up action items.
Linear project kickoff issue: define baseline time-to-ready, target reduction, scope boundaries, and initial work breakdown; links to Confluence overview.
Implement provisioning state machine (Requested → Provisioning → Imaging → Bootstrapping → Validating → Ready/Failed) with persisted transitions and audit trail.
Add Terraform orchestration wrapper to create/expand Dedicated pools with idempotency and retry semantics; define required inputs and outputs.
Golden image pipeline: build base GPU node image with pinned drivers/runtime prereqs; publish versioned artifact and document promotion steps.
Config schema + validation: define JSON schema for pool configs; implement lint and policy checks; add break-glass override with logging.
Readiness gates: GPU health check + networking/DNS/TLS checks + runtime smoke test; define pass/fail criteria and error messages.
Perf-canary integration for readiness: run a minimal benchmark to validate throughput/latency within thresholds before Ready.
Emit stage timing metrics and structured events; add correlation IDs for pool provisioning runs to trace across services.
Dashboard for time-to-ready with stage breakdown; define alert thresholds for stuck stages and high failure rate.
Add operator CLI command to trigger provisioning run and to re-run individual stages safely; include dry-run mode.
Manual override flow: document when and how to intervene; implement ‘pause’ and ‘resume’ controls with audit logging.
Staging environment pilot: run automation on an internal staging pool; capture failures and refine runbooks.
Customer pilot expansion: select one Dedicated customer expansion; define comms plan, success criteria, and rollback plan.
Add config drift detection between intended pool config and actual cluster/runtime settings; surface drift in dashboard.
Tighten RBAC for provisioning actions; ensure least-privilege and include security review checklist.
Backfill historical time-to-ready metrics from logs for baseline; produce before/after comparison.
Failure mode: imaging step timeouts on specific SKU/region; add detection + fallback (alternate image mirror or prewarm).
Improve provisioning visibility: post status updates to #eng-infra with stage updates and links (bot message).
Document and implement SLA for ‘ready’ marking in control plane; ensure routing only uses Ready capacity.
Sprint retro and follow-ups: compile action items, tech debt, and next sprint proposals.
Add provisioning state machine types and persistence layer changes; includes migration and backward compatibility notes.
Introduce structured provisioning events (stage start/finish/failure) with correlation IDs; plumbs through to logs/metrics.
Control plane API endpoint to trigger provisioning runs and query run status; includes authz checks and rate limits.
Implement Ready gating in routing integration: only advertise pools marked Ready; add safety fallback and metrics.
Add config schema validation library and initial rule set; includes unit tests and example configs.
Break-glass override support for config validation with audit log entries; adds admin-only control and alerting hook.
Operator CLI: provision run trigger + stage re-run; supports dry-run; prints links to dashboards.
Add drift detection job comparing desired vs actual runtime settings; surfaces drift in control plane UI/API fields.
Telemetry: time-to-ready metric (overall + per-stage histogram) and error categorization; includes cardinality safeguards.
Bot integration to post provisioning progress updates into Slack (#eng-infra) with stage durations and failure summaries.
Refactor Dedicated pool Terraform modules for idempotent apply; add standardized outputs consumed by orchestration.
Add regional defaults and guardrails (networking, IAM roles) for new pool creation; documents required variables.
Pin runtime chart versions and add bootstrap hooks for provisioning pipeline; includes rollback steps.
Add a lightweight ‘readiness suite’ benchmark mode optimized for new pools; outputs a simple pass/fail + summary JSON.
Add dashboards and alerts for provisioning stages and time-to-ready metrics; includes template variables for pool/customer.
New message template for provisioning failures with actionable links (runbook, logs, Linear issue); includes channel routing rules.
Add retry/backoff policy for imaging/bootstrap stages; ensures safe cancellation and avoids duplicate resource creation.
Improve error messages surfaced to operators for common provisioning failures (DNS/TLS, GPU health, quota); adds runbook pointers.
Security hardening: restrict provisioning service IAM permissions and rotate credentials; includes security review checklist in PR.
Add staging-only feature flag to enable new provisioning pipeline; includes rollout plan and metrics to monitor.
Fix: race condition causing Ready to be set before perf-canary completion; adds transactional check.
Add API support for pausing/resuming provisioning runs; includes audit logs and admin-only access.
Add support for partial stage re-run (e.g., re-run validation only) with cached artifacts; improves iteration speed.
Update documentation strings and examples for pool configs; aligns schema defaults with Dedicated product expectations.
Add integration tests for provisioning state machine transitions, including failure injection and rollback assertions.
Thread coordinating sprint kickoff: baseline numbers, who owns which pipeline stage, and links to Linear project/Confluence overview.
Thread investigating slow imaging step in one region; includes logs snippet, hypothesis (artifact mirror), and short-term workaround.
Thread on Terraform apply failures (IAM/quotas) during pilot; includes retry guidance and link to INT ticket.
Thread defining alert thresholds for ‘stuck provisioning stage’; debate about paging vs ticket creation; links to dashboard PR.
Thread discussing control-plane Ready semantics and whether routing should treat ‘Validating’ as usable; includes decision and follow-up.
Thread reviewing ADR-0142 orchestration model; questions about workflow engine vs internal service; approvals from infra/platform.
Thread: rollout checklist for enabling pipeline in staging; includes step-by-step commands and who is on point.
Thread from oncall noting repeated bootstrap failures; request for clearer runbook and better error classification.
Incident-style thread: provisioning runs stuck in ‘Bootstrapping’ due to misconfigured helm values; mitigations and follow-up actions.
Thread validating dashboards: does time-to-ready histogram match logs? includes screenshot stub and metric naming discussion.
Thread coordinating customer pilot expansion window and who will monitor; includes comms draft and escalation path.
Thread from Support asking for updated ETA language for Dedicated capacity readiness; links to Confluence and a Gmail thread.
Thread about implementing pause/resume and re-run semantics; concerns about idempotency and state consistency.
Thread: GPU health check failures (ECC errors) during validation; discussion about auto-replace and how to surface in status.
Thread: decision to create tickets automatically for non-paging failures; includes bot behavior changes.
Thread collecting pain points from operators using the new CLI; quick fixes and follow-up issues created.
Thread: schema validation breaking an edge-case config; discussion of adding a migration tool and temporary allowlist.
Thread coordinating release of provisioning feature flag to production; rollout steps, monitoring checklist, and rollback criteria.
Thread capturing early notes for retro/postmortem of the pilot incident; links to incident thread and PR that fixed race condition.
Thread with final sprint demo notes: before/after time-to-ready numbers, what shipped, what’s next.
Working doc with sprint scope, workstream owners, weekly milestones, and a living risk/mitigation list; links to Linear and Confluence.
Analysis doc compiling baseline time-to-ready from past 10 Dedicated pool bring-ups; includes stage estimates and top delay causes.
Spreadsheet-style table of provisioning runs with timestamps per stage, region, SKU, and outcome; used to compute p50/p95 and regressions.
Checklist for image build/promotion: driver versions, kernel params, security hardening items, smoke test commands, and rollback notes.
Rough notes exploring config fields to validate (network CIDRs, helm values, runtime flags), proposed defaults, and known footguns.
Draft alert list and paging policy for provisioning pipeline; includes open questions about noise and ownership boundaries.
Notes from platform team on Ready state semantics, API shapes, and backward compatibility with existing pool registration flows.
Step-by-step pilot run checklist (staging then prod), including comms, monitoring, and explicit rollback points.
Collected operator feedback on the provisioning CLI (pain points, missing flags, confusing errors) with prioritized fixes.
Raw retro notes (less polished than Confluence): what went well, what hurt, and candidate follow-ups for next cycle.
Internal support ticket: provisioning pipeline failing due to missing IAM permission in staging; includes logs, fix PR link, and resolution.
Internal support ticket: dashboard variables not populating for new pool IDs; request to Observability to update templates.
Internal support ticket: Slack bot posting duplicate stage updates; investigation notes and link to incident-bot PR.
Internal support ticket: config validation blocks legitimate edge-case; requests an allowlist + audit trail; links to ADR and Linear.
Customer ticket from a Dedicated customer reporting delayed capacity expansion readiness; includes impact, timeline, and status updates tied to pilot.
Customer ticket: intermittent 5xx during pool validation window; triage notes, mitigation (keep pool out of routing), and follow-up tasks.
Technical deep dive transcript with a Dedicated prospect/customer on provisioning lead times, readiness validation, and rollout expectations; includes next steps and action items.
POC check-in transcript where Redwood explains the new automation pilot and aligns on success criteria/ETA for adding more GPUs.
Security/compliance-flavored call touching on image provenance, audit logs for provisioning actions, and change-management expectations.
Email thread coordinating internal approvals and resourcing for the sprint (Infra + SRE + Platform), including timeline and explicit ownership asks.
Email thread with a customer (external) on Dedicated capacity expansion ETA; includes explanation of readiness gates and planned maintenance window.
Product/Eng email thread aligning Dedicated product commitments (lead time targets, what is ‘ready’) and how to message changes to Sales/CS.
Leadership escalation thread after a pilot hiccup: impact summary, mitigation, decision to proceed with staged rollout, and follow-up asks.

HubSpot company record for an enterprise prospect interested in Dedicated; notes emphasize strict capacity lead times, readiness validation, and change-management requirements; links to Fireflies and Gmail threads.
HubSpot company record for a mid-market customer expanding Dedicated usage; includes activity timeline, blockers (region/SKU availability), and provisioning ETA updates.
HubSpot company record for a regulated prospect asking about image hardening and audit logs for provisioning actions; ties into security review call.
